title: Drake and Adin Ross Launch Anita Max Win Tour with DRIZZMAS Stream
htmlContent:
Drake and Adin Ross collaborated for an unforgettable livestream that delighted fans worldwide before the Anita Max Win Tour. Dubbed 'DRIZZMAS,' the event began with unveiling a stunning custom tour chain designed to resemble the face of the tour's mascot. Adin Ross wore the one-of-a-kind, multi-colored diamond piece live for the first time. In its first hour, over 180,000 viewers watched the stream, celebrating positive vibes and fan appreciation. Drake, affectionately called 'The 6 God,' paused to reflect on those who influenced his life before fame, adding an emotional touch to the evening.

Unfiltered Fun and Giveaways

As the stream progressed, the tone became more unfiltered, which resulted in an 18-and-over restriction after the first hour. Drake and Ross toasted viewers with shots, drinks, and candid banter, and were joined by special guest comedian BenDaDonnn, who brought his signature humor. BenDaDonnn decided to be generous and offer a Lamborghini as a giveaway prize to in-studio crew members who don't own a foreign car. Fans won many prizes, including trips to see Drake perform in Australia, luxury vacations, cash prizes, and even signed memorabilia as a major highlight of the giveaways. Drake read heartfelt stories from winners personally before talking to them live to announce their prizes, which added a personal touch that viewers deeply felt.

Drizzy’s Upcoming Projects

Drake revealed a new cologne that is going to be released soon, giving fans another exciting project to look forward to. He shared a humorous moment on the stream when he compared his appearance to MMA legend Conor McGregor. Drake's admiration for 'The Notorious One' solidified his fandom when he was asked about his favorite UFC fighter.

Fueling Tour Excitement

Stake presented the live stream as a promotional event for Drake's Anita Max Win Tour, which kicks off in February. “February 9th for anybody that’s watching from Australia, I’m coming back to Australia for the first time in eight years. Coming back to Australia on tour,” Drake shared during the livestream. “Melbourne, Sydney, Gold Coast… February 9 ’til like… March something.” Fans across Australia can now experience an unforgettable experience thanks to the availability of tickets for the tour. Adin Ross has announced plans to return to streaming next week after a hiatus, bringing more excitement to the event. The DRIZZMAS live stream, which featured heartfelt stories, lavish prizes, and Drake's distinctive charm, set the tone for celebrating fans, music, and milestones on the global stage.
